highlights_headline: The next m150 servicing update corrects region construction, texture sampling and failed runtime-shader pipelines.

bullets.detail: Budgets region storage for subdivided conics and checks accumulation overflow. Failed runtime-shader stage construction no longer leaves unresolved branches executable in a partial Raster Pipeline.
Disables an unsupported GLES upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx, and preserves nearest-filtered texture subset clamps when sampling could reach neighboring texels.
